customers.evidence: Our curiosity drives us to better understand what our customers do, how they do it, and what they need to help overcome their challenges.

employees.evidence: it all starts with competent and talented teams working together

community.evidence: maximizing positive influence on the communities in which we live and work

innovation.evidence: Our story begins with what it truly means to be a technology innovator.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, identity-driven first-person plural voice centred on innovation as the core theme. Customers are addressed through curiosity and understanding of their needs. Environment and community appear as hedged, process-level aims ('minimizing', 'maximizing') rather than absolute commitments. Safety, integrity and shareholder value are absent. Much text is metaphorical or historical rather than stated values.
